presentation.summary: One owner-reviewable batch for an aerobic-capacity DEVELOP priority: a fixed ten-minute starting duration, a hard twelve-minute progression ceiling, two weekly scheduling slots, conservative readiness reductions, and a separately governed distance-response review.

authority_basis.scientific_support: The reviewed ACSM position stand supports regular individualized aerobic exercise for apparently healthy adults and notes that volumes below the full public-health target may still be beneficial. It does not establish this exact modality, duration, effort range, weekly frequency, progression increment, ceiling, or response threshold.
authority_basis.engineering_prior: The 10-minute start, 12-minute session envelope, two-session frequency, RPE 4-6 range, RPE 5 progression gate, 60-second increment, 720-second ceiling, 80% review adherence threshold, 50-meter response criterion, and modification mappings are explicit conservative engineering priors. Ratification accepts them provisionally and does not relabel them as scientific findings.

exact_artifacts: One fixed-duration dose policy for an exact below-floor 12-minute walk/run-distance estimate and aerobic-capacity DEVELOP priority.
One duration progression policy that adds 60 seconds only after complete, technique-compliant work at session RPE 5 or below and never beyond 720 seconds.
One weekly scheduling policy and approved review, one block-review policy and distance-response authority, and one non-diagnostic session-safety policy.
governs: Derivation of one 600-second continuous aerobic set without converting assessment meters into training seconds.
A 12-minute scheduling envelope with target effort RPE 4-6 and walking always permitted.
Later progression by 60 seconds only after compliant completion, with an absolute 720-second per-set ceiling.
does_not_establish: Medical clearance, diagnosis, running readiness, injury prediction, pain tolerance, or permission to ignore concerning symptoms.
That 10 or 12 minutes, two sessions, RPE 4-6, the RPE 5 progression gate, the 60-second increment, or the 50-meter response threshold is an ACSM recommendation or scientific optimum.
A required speed, incline, running interval, heart-rate zone, calorie target, or VO2 estimate.
An athlete-specific session, scheduled week, completed training exposure, guaranteed response, or permission to train.
unresolved_limitations: The exact operational constants have not been calibrated against this athlete's repeated aerobic response.
Treadmill walking or running is one feasible means and may not transfer identically to other aerobic modalities.
Perceived effort and conversational control cannot verify physiology, gait quality, or medical safety.
The athlete must still have a current exact estimate, below-floor capability need, DEVELOP priority, feasible environment, reviewed block, and current session-safety clearance.

evidence.title: ACSM position stand on exercise quantity and quality (2011)
evidence.supported_use: Regular aerobic exercise improves cardiorespiratory fitness in apparently healthy adults, should be individualized, and can provide benefit below the full public-health target.
evidence.unsupported_specifics: The source does not validate treadmill superiority, a 10-minute starting duration, two weekly sessions, RPE 4-6, a 60-second progression, a 720-second ceiling, or a 50-meter response threshold.

weekly_scheduling_policy_review_content.applicability_rationale: Approve only for the owner-alpha aerobic-capacity DEVELOP pathway with an exact fully feasible treadmill walk/run resolution, no partial substitution, and no same-day repeat.
weekly_scheduling_policy_review_content.uncertainty: The one-session daily cap and 24-hour high-fatigue interval are conservative engineering constraints, not values extracted from the cited position stand. The planned sessions are moderate fatigue, so the high-fatigue interval is a forward-compatible guardrail.

adjustment.description: Add 60 seconds to the continuous set after full compliant completion, without exceeding the reviewed 720-second ceiling.

progression_policy.rationale: Progress only after the entire planned duration was completed at session RPE 5 or below, the reviewed movement and intensity constraints were maintained, and no post-session safety decision interrupted progression. A completed RPE 6 session remains valid work but holds duration. The hard ceiling prevents indefinite automatic duration growth.

technique_constraints: Use a sustainable walk or familiar walk-run pace that keeps effort within RPE 4-6; walking is always permitted.
Do not introduce running solely to satisfy the prescription, and do not chase assessment pace, distance, speed, or incline.
Stop for pain, chest discomfort, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, instability, or any concerning change in current state.
fixed_duration_dose_policy.rationale: Begin with ten minutes of continuous moderate aerobic work inside a twelve-minute scheduling envelope, keeping the training dose independent of the athlete's field-test distance and allowing response to be observed before progression.
fixed_duration_dose_policy.uncertainty: Every numeric value is a provisional engineering prior. The evidence supports only the broad aerobic-training direction and does not establish that this dose is optimal, sufficient, or safe for every current state.

block_review_policy.rationale: Interpret the completed owner-alpha aerobic block only when at least 80 percent of prescribed work was delivered and the exact governed follow-up estimate retains at least low confidence. These cutoffs are conservative engineering review rules, not effect thresholds reported by ACSM.

response_evaluation_authority.rationale: Use a 50-meter increase as the provisional owner-alpha response threshold, large enough to exceed the one-meter entry resolution while remaining visibly separate from the competency floor and any VO2 conversion.
response_evaluation_authority.uncertainty: Route accuracy, treadmill calibration, pacing, motivation, conditions, footwear, recent fatigue, and walking or running familiarity can easily affect distance. Fifty meters is an accountable engineering prior, not a validated minimal detectable change or proof of training causality.

session_safety_policy.rationale: Permit only conservative reductions for ordinary limited readiness, soreness, sleep disruption, or schedule limitation. Concerning symptoms remain stop conditions governed outside this modification policy and cannot be overridden by it.

release.release_rationale: Install the minimum explicit authorities needed to turn a governed aerobic-capacity deficit into a bounded duration prescription and later compare the exact reassessment against its baseline, while preventing assessment meters from becoming training-duration arithmetic.
release.release_uncertainty: The broad strategy is evidence-linked, but all exact dose, ceiling, recovery, progression, modification, adherence, and meaningful-change values are provisional engineering priors. Ratification creates reusable authorities only; athlete-specific derivation, environment resolution, safety review, scheduling, execution, reassessment, and causal interpretation remain separate.
